patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I ran clean out of my blood pressure pills on a cruise, and my regular doctor is booked solid until roughly the Rapture. I feel perfectly fine. I just need the little pink one, dear.
presentation.triageNote: 67-year-old female, ran out of her blood-pressure medication, feels well, here for a refill.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: Discharge is appropriate because no emergency treatment-area resource is expected and medication guidance with follow-up addresses the current need.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This is an asymptomatic medication-refill request with mildly elevated blood pressure and no presented evidence of acute end-organ injury.
clinical.acuityReason: The patient feels well, has no pain or concerning symptoms, and has otherwise stable vital signs.
expectedResources: Medication reconciliation and brief clinical assessment
keyFindings: Ran out of prescribed blood-pressure medication
teachingPoints: An elevated blood-pressure reading without symptoms is not by itself evidence of a hypertensive emergency.
Medication access and safe follow-up planning may be the principal needs.

possibleDiagnoses: Asymptomatic hypertension related to interrupted medication access
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: After medication verification and a brief assessment, the patient could receive bridge-prescription guidance, return precautions, and primary-care follow-up without emergency testing.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 67-year-old woman with a sun hat and a tote bag
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting comfortably, purse on her lap, chatting
aiImageGeneration.expression: cheerful and chatty, completely at ease
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. ANATOMY AND OBJECTS (critical): exactly one head, exactly two arms ending in exactly two hands, exactly two legs ending in two feet, five fingers on each hand. No extra, duplicated, floating or partial limbs anywhere. Anything the character touches must be plausibly held by one of those two hands. All furniture is solid and fully opaque - the chair must never look transparent or see-through, and its back, seat and legs must all be completely drawn. Subject: a Hispanic 67-year-old woman with a sun hat and a tote bag, on the same blue clinic chair. Pose: sitting comfortably, purse on her lap, mid-chat. Expression: cheerful and chatty, completely at ease. Clearly visible: relaxed upright posture, bright and well-appearing. Overall well and comfortable. No text, no logos.
